name: mesh-set
note: The mesh set (plan §3, step 2) as recipes in tools/meshgen/shells.py, written to pack/meshes as <family>_<name>.obj. Not uploaded: meshes go up with the textures through the ledger script.

mesh/crescent_wide.use: a heavy slash: the slash-erodes sequence on a wide, deep shell

mesh/crescent_thin.use: a quick slash or an afterimage arc

mesh/cone.use: a burst thrown up from the ground; a shockwave with height

mesh/sphere.use: a dome flash or a shield

mesh/torus.use: a hard ring that keeps its thickness at any angle

mesh/cylinder.use: a light pillar or a beam's body
